introduction.source: Private questions are visible to you. Unlisted questions are available through their link. Public questions can appear in the answer archive.
introduction.text: 私密问题仅您可见。不列出的问题可通过链接访问。公开问题可出现在答案归档中。

inactive.source: Question privacy controls are unavailable in this deployment. Existing question visibility is unchanged.
inactive.text: 此部署不提供问题隐私控件。现有问题可见性保持不变。

retention.source: This original has a retention hold. Its financial proof must be preserved.
retention.text: 此原始记录受保留限制。其财务证明必须保留。

signIn.source: Sign in with your wallet to manage question privacy.
signIn.text: 使用钱包登录以管理问题隐私。

admission.source: Question privacy is awaiting storage admission.
admission.text: 问题隐私正在等待存储准入。

retry.source: The request could not be completed. Refresh and retry.
retry.text: 无法完成请求。请刷新并重试。

accountChanged.source: Account changed. Refresh this page to continue.
accountChanged.text: 账户发生变化。刷新此页面以继续。

erased.source: Question and answer erased. Financial records and run ID retained.
erased.text: 问题和答案已删除。财务记录和研究 ID 已保留。

eraseExplanation.source: Erasure removes this question, answer and derived research text. Run ID, settlement proofs and financial records remain. Copies already downloaded by others cannot be recalled.
eraseExplanation.text: 删除会移除此问题、答案和派生研究文本。研究 ID、结算证明和财务记录将保留。其他人已下载的副本无法收回。
